{{samename|character from [[Mewtwo Returns]]|Luna Carson}} ---- [[File:Luna.png|thumb|250px|Luna]] '''Luna''' (Japanese: '''ルナ''' ''Luna'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG166|Curbing the Crimson Tide!]]''. Luna is a wealthy young girl who lives in [[Commerce City]] in the [[Kanto]] [[region]]. She grew up increasingly lonely, as her parents often left home to continue their scientific work. To occupy her active mind, she turned her {{p|Scizor}} into the caped menace known as ''Red Lightning'' (Japanese: '''赤いイナズマ'''). She also put a small radio around its neck to make it appear like it was talking, causing further confusion as to whether Red Lightning was human or Pokémon. She used a microphone on her laptop to provide Red Lightning's voice. Soon, Red Lightning crossed paths with {{an|May}} and her {{TP|May|Squirtle}}. Squirtle was easily defeated with a {{m|Hyper Beam}} attack. With the help of {{TRT}}'s [[Transportation|balloon]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were able to track down Red Lightning to Luna's estate and discover her antics. Luna challenged Ash to a [[Pokémon battle]]. Ash initially chose {{AP|Pikachu}} to battle Red Lightning, but when he realized that he needed a Pokémon who can scale buildings, he switched out to {{AP|Sceptile}}. Everyone soon realized that Luna was using the city updrafts to make it appear that Scizor was flying, with Sceptile copying Scizor's technique to even the playing field and eventually win the battle. Scizor began to fall after being knocked unconscious, but Sceptile saved it. After Luna's butler revealed that Luna was often lonely, May started to relate to her and said that she sometimes missed her parents while she was on her journey. Soon, May challenged Luna to a rematch with her Squirtle. This time around, Squirtle was the victor. After the battle, Luna promised not to cause trouble anymore, but she made May promise her that she would come to visit her again someday. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Luna |pkmn=Scizor |stage1=Scyther |type1=Bug |type2=Steel |img=Luna younger.png |img2={{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: H}} mod 3}}|0|1=Red Lightning|2=Luna Scizor}}.png |cap=Luna's Scyther |cap2={{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: H}} mod 3}}|0|1=Red Lightning|2=Luna's Scizor}} |epnum=AG166 |epname=Curbing the Crimson Tide! |vajp= |vaen=Rodger Parsons |vaennote=as Red Lightning |vaen2=Eric Stuart |vaen2note=as a Scizor itself |desc=Luna's {{p|Scizor}} is Luna's only known Pokémon. Luna helped raise Scizor ever since it was a {{p|Scyther}}. Following its [[Evolution]], Luna transformed her Scizor into ''Red Lightning'' (Japanese: '''赤いイナズマ'''); a caped-wearing and incredibly powerful alias that took great pride in defeating Trainers across [[Commerce City]]. Its impeccable speed and Hyper Beam helped it defeats its unwilling opponents. Every Pokémon that got defeated by Red Lightning got marked on. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, with the help of {{TRT}}'s balloon, eventually discovered Red Lightning's true identity. Luna eventually shelved Red Lightning after {{an|May}} defeated Scizor using her {{TP|May|Squirtle}}, helping her to realize that there were better ways to have fun other than causing mischief. Red Lightning's known moves are {{m|Hyper Beam}}, {{m|Agility}}, and {{m|Swift}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{bug color}}|bordercolor={{bug color light}} |ja=植田佳奈 ''[[Kana Ueda]]'' |en=[[Sarah Natochenny]] |it=Laura Brambilla |fi=Henna Haverinen |fr_eu=Fanny Roy |pt_br=Gilmara Sanchez |es_la=Cristina Hernández |es_eu=Pilar Puebla}}
